title: Adapter entries
description: The adapter keys of a machine config, and the files under adapters/ that hold entries to copy into one. pipeline/adapter_config.py validates the same rules and more: which {placeholders} each kind and each field may use, that ids are unique and that defaults name a configured adapter of their kind. Other machine config keys are described in docs/machine_settings.md.

id.description: What a pipeline stage, a job or an API request names to choose this adapter.

kind.description: What the adapter makes; docs/adapters.md lists the placeholders and outputs of each kind.

argv.description: The program and its arguments, one string each; never a shell line. argv[0], env values and cwd may use only {python} and {repo}; the other arguments may also use the run's placeholders for the kind ({prompt}, {seed}, {image}, {mesh}, {rig}, {output}, {out_dir}, {params.NAME} and so on). Write {{ and }} for literal braces.

gpu.description: Hold the machine-wide GPU lock while it runs.

weights.description: A file or folder whose hash joins the model identity.
